IncidentBot: Incident created INC-2026-03-05-21987 — P0 — model-serving latency spike. Pager routed to @Jordan (oncall).
Jordan (oncall): seeing elevated 95th latency for text-gen cluster, errors from worker pool. Digging in now. :mag:
Priya Rao: thanks. quick ask — as we triage can we draft a short internal update and a status-page blurb? keep it conservative on impact.
Sam Whitaker: on it. can we standardize the structure? I'm thinking: 1) What happened 2) Customer impact 3) Mitigation steps 4) ETA/next update 5) Contacts. Short bullets.
Chen Li: agree. also include placeholders for affected models, regions, and whether data plane requests persisted. e.g., {models_impacted}, {regions}, {request_failure_rate}.
Tilly (ops_comm): drafting two tone variants — "operative neutral" for infra teams and "customer-safe" for status page/email. will paste snippets.
Tilly (ops_comm): INTERNAL UPDATE (short):
```
INCIDENT {incident_id} — {short_desc}
Status: Investigating
Scope: {models_impacted} in {regions}
Impact: Elevated latency and intermittent 5xxs; ~{request_failure_rate}% of requests affected
Mitigation: Rolling back recent routing change and scaling additional nodes; on-call is running health checks
ETA: Next update in 20m or when there is a material change
Contacts: {oncall}, {sre_lead}
```
Use this as the first post in #incidents and thread into the incident channel.
Priya Rao: good. add a line reminding not to do deep root-cause speculation in public posts. keep it factual.
Tilly (ops_comm): noted — added: "We are investigating the root cause and will share verified details as they become available." as standard sentence.
Chen Li: STATUS PAGE BLURB (customer-safe):
```
Title: Service disruption affecting text generation
Status: Investigating
Start time: {start_time}
Impact: Some API requests experience higher latency or fail intermittently. We are working to restore normal service.
Updates: {status_page_url}/incidents/{incident_id}
ETA: Next update by {eta}
```
Sam Whitaker: for email/large-customer PD, propose slightly expanded with known impact windows and a safe workaround if available. e.g., "If you encounter errors, retry after 30s; use model X as a fallback: {fallback_model}."
Jordan (oncall): mitigation log: rolled routing rollback at 2198765402, added 2 nodes to pool at 2198765460, started health checks. preliminary latency down 30% but 95th still above SLO.
Priya Rao: ok include that operational timeline in internal posts. also add an "affected customers" placeholder list so CSMs can quickly copy/paste.
Tilly (ops_comm): CUSTOMER NOTIFICATION TEMPLATE (concise):
```
Hi {customer_name},
We are investigating an issue impacting {models_impacted} in {regions} which may cause higher latency or errors. Our engineers are working on a fix.
We will provide an update by {eta}.
We apologize for the disruption.
— Redwood Inference Status Team
```
Chen Li: tone guidance: keep customer-facing copy empathetic but not overly technical. Avoid speculative causes. Provide clear next-step and ETA placeholders. Use plain language.
Sam Whitaker: internal-only checklist snippet for the comms owner:
- Confirm affected regions/models
- Confirm mitigation actions and timestamps
- Verify impact window and customer list
- Get sign-off from SRE lead before wide customer emails
- Post status page update + incident channel update

Jordan (oncall): latest: 95th latency trending down after scale, error rate 0.9% now (was 4.7%). continuing monitoring.
Tilly (ops_comm): I'll push a first-pass status update to the status page and queue the customer note for review. attaching draft in thread in ~5m.
Priya Rao: thank you. once we have stable metrics for 10min, we can move status to "identified" and add a brief note on cause investigation steps.
Sam Whitaker: one more: add a short "what not to say" list for internal comms templates: no timelines without SRE consent, avoid root-cause attribution, don't share internal IPs or hostnames in customer messages.
Tilly (ops_comm): added. final note: recommend we version these templates and keep a changelog in the comms repo, and tag templates with permitted uses (status-page, email, internal).
Chen Li: +1 on changelog. also add placeholder tags for severity and whether a post-incident follow-up (RCA) is planned: {severity_level}, {followup_required}.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-03-05-21987 updated: status -> Investigating; severity -> P0; assignees -> Jordan (oncall), Sam Whitaker, Chen Li.
Priya Rao: great work team. let's keep updates short and focused. next update in 20m or when we transition to identified/mitigated. :white_check_mark:
